paite: Huan David dam lai in kum kizom in kum thum kial akia hi. David in TOUPA adong a, TOUPA'N, "Saul leh sisan suahmi a-inkote ziak ahi. Amau Gibeon mite athat ngal ua," achi hi.
heading: Saul Suante Thah In A-om Uh

paite: Kumpipa'n Gibeon mite asam a, akiang uah, Gibeon mite Israel suante ahi kei ua, Amor mi khosuaksunte ahi zaw uh. Israel suante amau kiang ah ana kichiam khin ua; Saul in Israel suante leh Judah suante a dia phatuam angaih ziak in thah atum nak hi.
David in Gibeon mite kiang ah, "Bang ahia ka hon hihsak ding? TOUPA gou na vualzawl theihna ding un bangchibang in hihdik thak nawnna ka bawl dia?" achi hi.

Gibeon mite'n akiang ah, "Saul leh a-inkote dangka leh dangka-eng ka la kei ding uh. Kou ziak in Israel ah mi kuamah na that kei ding uh," achi uhi. Ama'n, "Na gen peuhmah uh ka hon hihsak ding,” achi hi.
Amau kumpipa kiang ah, "Hon hihmangpa leh Israel gamsung himhim a om lou dia hihmang hon sawmpa,
tapa sagihte hon pia inla, TOUPA miseh Saul omna Gibeah ah TOUPA ma ah ka khailum ding uh," achi uh. Kumpipa'n, "Hon pe leng ake," achi hi.
Himahleh kumpipa'n, David leh Saul tapa Jonathan kikal a, anih ua kal a TOUPA kichiamna ziak in Saul tapa Jonathan tapa Mephibosheth ahawi hi.
Kumpipa'n Aiah tanu Rizpah in Saul tapa nih aneihsak Armoni leh Mephibosheth api a, Meholath mi Barzillai tapa Adriel, Saul tanu Mikal in tapa nga aneihsakte toh
Gibeon mite khut ah apekhia a, mual a TOUPA ma ah akhailum uhi. Huchi in asagih un asikhawm uhi. Buh lak hun, barli buhlak pat lai in athatta uhi.

Aiah tanu Rizpah in sai-ip puan ala a, amah a ding in suangpi tung ah aphah hi. Buh lak kipat tung a pan huai siluangte tung a van vuahtui in abuah tan in, sun chia siluangte tung a vasate atuk ding uh leh zan chia gamsate khoih ding aphal kei hi.
Aiah tanu, Saul meinu Rizpah thilhih David ahilh uhi.

Huchi in David akuan a, Philistia mite'n Gilboa a Saul athah ni ua Philistia mite'n Beth-shan mun lian a akhai uh aguhte uh, Jabesh-gilead mite'n ava guklak uh, Saul guh leh atapa Jonathan guhte ala hi.
Huai a pan Saul guhte leh atapa Jonathan guhte alatou a; akhailupte uh guhte leng alakhawm hi.
Saul guhte leh atapa Jonathan guhte Benjamin gam a Jelaha apa Kish han ah avui uh. Kumpipa thupiak dungzui in ahih uhi. Huai khit in huai gam tung ah Pathian alungkimta hi.
Philistia mite'n Israel mite adou nawn uhi. David, amite toh ava kuansuk ua; Philistia mite ava sual ua, David abah mahmah hi.
heading: Philistia Miliante Douna / (1 Kro 20.4-8)

paite: Ishbi-benob, milian tapate lak a khat, ateipi gikdan dal shekel zathum, namsau thak kuah in David thah atum hi.

Himahleh Zeruiah tapa Abishai in ahong hunkhia a, Philistia mi sual in athatta hi. David mite'n, "Israelte khawnvak na mihsaklouhna ding in kidou ding in ka kiang uah nang zaw na kuan nawn kei ding," chi in akiang ah akichiam uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gob ah Philistiate toh kidouna dang khat a-om nawn hi. Huai hun in Hushat mi Sibbekai in milian suante lak a khat Saph kichi athat hi.
Philistia mite toh Gob ah akidou nawn uh. Bethlehem mi Jaar oregim tapa Elhanan in Git mi Goliath unaupa athat a, huai mi teipi tuh siam kolpi bang ahi.
Gath ah kidouna a-om nawn hi. Huai ah mi khat asan a sang, akhut langkhat tuaktuak a khutzung guk, akhe langkhat tuaktuak a khezung guk, avek a sawmnih-le-li nei a-om hi. Amah leng milian suan ahi.
Ama'n Israel mite ava chou a, David unau, Shimei tapa Jonathan in ana that hi.
Huai lite Gath a milian suante ahi ua, huchi in David leh amite khut in asita uhi.
